description: Best tool for wellness trends over weeks or months ('has my sleep improved', 'resting HR trend this year', 'stress lately'). Returns per-period averages only: steps, resting HR, stress, Body Battery high/low, intensity minutes (totals), respiration, sleep hours/deep/REM/score, overnight HRV, with min-max ranges for key metrics and day counts where data is missing. group_by='weekday' answers 'which days do I sleep worst / most stressed'. Range up to 366 days; fetches and aggregates in the server.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

include.description: Data sources to include. Drop ones the question doesn't need for a faster answer.

period.description: Named period resolved in the user's time zone (weeks start Monday). Use instead of start_date/end_date.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Required unless period is given.

name: summarize_wellness
title: Summarize wellness trends
